name: M4A1
source: A relatively reserved girl who, despite her nature, tries her absolute best at everything from sports to grades and is fairly competitive. Clumsy, lacks self-confidence, often confers to M16 and others for help and gradually becomes more of her own person over time. Competes in the next year’s Student Council Election against ST AR-15 (and other Dolls). Will eventually win the fight, which will lead to broken bonds (aka Shattered Connection).
